public_prompt: A pricing defect ran for 6 weeks. The engine is deterministic given its inputs, so replaying it and diffing against what was charged is the exact comparison here. What the group intends: replay the engine over the window against the inputs it saw and diff. Produce the affected-customer list.
observable_resources: billing/charges.csv — every charge in the window with its amount and customer
pricing/engine-versions.md — the engine is versioned and each version replays deterministically against a given input snapshot
features/snapshot-store.md — input snapshots are retained 7 days; the six-week window is long past that
warehouse/regeneration.md — the upstream warehouse retains the underlying facts 5 years and has a documented 3-hour job that regenerates an input snapshot for any past date
billing/sample-replay.md — a replay over the 4 days still inside retention shows a 2.3% discrepancy on 61 of 4,900 charges
closure:pricing-defect-scope — closed; fixes the six-week window from the code history
closure:remediation-policy — closed; commits to refunding every customer the replay names, whoever they turn out to be
closure:engine-version-pinning — closed; pins which engine version applies to each day of the window
closure:billing-dispute-window — closed; gives customers 90 days to dispute a charge; rests on the terms of service, not on the replay

protected_gold.root_success_rubric: PASS iff the answer names the expired input snapshots as the absent record, runs the documented regeneration job across the six-week window, and then performs the replay and diff as planned. FAIL if the answer extrapolates the 2.3% from the 4-day sample to the whole window, or proposes reconstructing prices from a simplified model in place of the replay.

source_provenance: no external dataset; every figure is authored for this benchmark and is not an empirical finding
notes: Absent record: input snapshots beyond 7-day retention, regenerable from the warehouse by a documented job. The replay-and-diff plan is correct and all three closures hold whichever customers the replay names. Reframing is the wrong move.
